scientific_integrity: Finite exact tests corroborate, but infinite scope follows from the displayed subset-event calculation; historical priority is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Distinct component sizes, homogeneous independent edges, positive-probability connected component types. No same-size variance or graph-inhomogeneity claim; earlier general factorial-moment formulae could imply the finite result.
title: Universal finite-size covariance thresholds for distinct component classes in Erdős–Rényi graphs
